notes: For every chronological fold, the existing pb_activity surface is loaded from the base experiment and frozen before any lag coefficient is estimated.
The lag layer is calibrated on bars ending before that fold's train_end and then applied unchanged throughout the fold's test interval.

The signed lag impulse is the previous bar's frozen P&B predicted impact multiplied by current-side times previous-side, so it is positive for same-sign pressure and negative for opposite-sign pressure.
bias_only estimates separate buy and sell mean residuals so that a level correction cannot be misattributed to lagged impact.
lag_activity interacts lagged impact with previous log activity relative to the normal activity level already fitted in the frozen P&B calibration.
lag_activity_duration additionally interacts lagged impact with current log duration centred on a training-only median.
